research_question: Can EMA + ATR trailing exits convert the frozen causal NEARUSDT 1h market-structure entry into a robust positive-expectancy long-only strategy?
prior_observation: The 2024-2025 baseline entry/structure-exit experiment has already been observed. Therefore 2025 is a retrospective test partition, not an untouched final holdout.

split.note: Chronological only. No shuffling. A genuinely untouched final test requires future data after this research.

frozen_entry.rule: At least 2 confirmed LL events, then confirmed HL, HH, HL, HH. Signal available only on confirmation of second HH.
frozen_entry.pivot_confirmation: 1.0 x ATR14 reversal using close confirmation. Historical extremum is not available until confirmation.
frozen_entry.execution: Entry decision at signal-bar close; fill next bar open. Long-only, 100% equity notional, no leverage, no pyramiding.

exit_grid.rule: For an open long at close t: atr_trail_t = highest_close_since_entry_t - k * ATR14_t; exit_level_t = max(EMA_n_t, atr_trail_t). If close_t < exit_level_t, queue exit for next bar open.
exit_grid.end_of_sample: Liquidate remaining position at final close and label it end_of_sample_liquidation.

costs.funding_note: No exact canonical NEAR funding-rate file was found in the current crypto dataset path. Premium-index data is not silently substituted for realized funding.

sweep_and_selection.train_sweep: Evaluate all 20 configurations on train at 10 bps per side.
sweep_and_selection.neighborhood: Grid-adjacent cells within one EMA index step and one ATR index step, including self.
sweep_and_selection.train_plateau_score: Median annualized daily Sharpe across the local neighborhood.
sweep_and_selection.train_profitable_fraction: Fraction of local-neighborhood cells with positive train net return.
sweep_and_selection.candidates: Take top 5 configurations by train_plateau_score; tie-break by train_profitable_fraction, then lower absolute max drawdown.
sweep_and_selection.validation: Evaluate only those top 5 candidates on 2024 validation.
sweep_and_selection.final_selection: Select candidate maximizing min(train_plateau_score, validation_sharpe). Tie-break by validation net return, then lower validation max drawdown.
sweep_and_selection.validation_gate: Record PASS only if selected candidate has validation net return > 0 and validation Sharpe > 0. Selection still exists for diagnostic test even if the gate fails.
sweep_and_selection.test: Evaluate only the selected configuration on 2025 retrospective test. Do not use test results to change parameters.

diagnostics: baseline comparison to prior structure+48h result where comparable

trial_accounting.note: The 20 exit configurations count as 20 explicit research trials. Cost stresses are diagnostics, not selection variants.
